page.layout: One page of text, two oval woodcut portraits at the top, running text below in one column. No margin notes, no notes below the text.

main_text.p: PLATO Philosophus Ariftone Patricio inter Athenien- fes ciue,& Periεtiona fiue Prona natus eft.claruit circa annum mundi 3575. ante Chriftum natum 387. à corporis habitu egregio, Plato dictus eft, aut ab orationis vbertate & mira amplitudine, cùm prius Ariftocles ex aui nomine diceretur: 20.annos natus, Poëticam miro complexus eft ingenio: celebratas Tragœdias, atque alia carmina fcripfit, fuauíque vocis fono pronuntiauit,nisi quòd ad gracilitatem tenderet. Poftea Philofophiam amplexatus, Poëticam reliquit: Socratis difcipulus fuit, & Ariftotelis ac Xenocratis præceptor. Ter militauit,egregiúmque militem fe præftitit. Ter in Siciliam navigauit: tertiò rediens,venundatus,atque à Dionyfio Tyranno extrema penè paffus eft. In Ægypto didicit quæcunq; illic magna habebantur. Philofophiam in moralem,naturalem,& rationalem diftribuit. Varia de eius morte fcribuntur. Vixit annos 8o. Vide Dioge.Laër.libr.3. Auguft.de ciuit.Dei lib.8.ca.4. & Plutar.in eius vita.
main_text.head: ARISTOTELES patre Nicomacho medico,natus eft in obfcuro oppido Stagira: vbi adoleuit, Athenas ftudiorum gratia miffus eft. Platonem audiuit annos 2 o.Deinde in Macedoniam euocatus à Philippo, & Alexandro filio in difciplinam tradito, maximam autoritatem in regno promeruit. huius fcripta extant quàm plurima, quæ vel ad eloquentiam fpeftant, vel ad ciuilem, moralémque difciplinam, vel ad fecreta naturæ. Dioge.Laër.lib.5.Plutar.in eius vita.

page.notes: Two oval woodcut portraits above the text: left inscribed "PLATO" and "ΦΗΣ" (Greek, as printed, partly unclear); right inscribed "ARISTOTELES" and "STAGIRITES". The "ARISTOTELES" opening line is set in spaced capitals and treated as a paragraph opener. Possible printing irregularity: "Periεtiona" is printed with a Greek-looking letter for "ct" and is copied as printed; the ο in "Ariftone" etc. is as printed. Some letters in the running head and page number are faint.
